agency.name: North Dakota Department of Health and Human Services — Behavioral Health Division

narrNote: North Dakota does not appear on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, reviewed 2026-10-22); no NARR state affiliate operates in North Dakota.
notes: Agency phone is the ND HHS Behavioral Health line published on the division's SUD Voucher page (also the Behavioral Health Navigator number). FirstLink is both North Dakota's 2-1-1 and the local answerer for 988 in ND, covering all ND counties (plus Clay County, MN); its searchable resource directory is linked from its homepage under 'Search For Resources' — the directory portal URL itself could not be re-verified in this run (fetch rate-limited), so the verified homepage is recorded as the countyDirectory gateway. A state Recovery Month release also lists Recovery Talk, a 24/7 peer support line (call/text 701-291-7901). North Dakota has no Section 1115 SUD IMD waiver; the state-funded SUD Voucher program recorded under medicaidSud is the payment bridge for SUD treatment and is administered alongside ND Medicaid (voucher applicants who appear Medicaid-eligible are routed into the Medicaid application). F5 Project is a peer-led (lived-experience) reentry and recovery organization serving all eight ND regions and delivering Free Through Recovery / Community Connect peer support.
